_superseded_why: Three defects, found by putting the design through a simulation before running it. (1) Three wordings per condition makes the wording-level test powerless by construction: C(6,3)=20 label assignments, so the smallest attainable p is 0.05 and the test can never fire -- measured power exactly 0.00. (2) One shared relative tolerance cannot judge six significant digits, because the same digit count means different relative errors at different mantissas. (3) Two conditions cannot separate 'names R' from 'looks like a software project'. The replacement uses 4 conditions x 12 wordings x 6 replicates.
_what: Everything that must be decided before the batch runs, written down so it cannot be decided afterwards. commit this file, then run. If any of it changes, the plan_id changes and the change is visible in history.
_plan_id_note: sha of (arm table + prompt + schema + 'rep-major'). Reproduce with: python tools/batch_plan.py --task norris-ols --k 8 --family r-eco,placebo. A different k, task, arm set or order yields a different id.
order: rep-major (one replicate of every arm, then the next)
_why_these_arms: Each condition gets three wordings, so the conclusion is about the category rather than about one lucky string (DESIGN.md section 5). The placebo wordings cost 11 tokens each on the arm table, exactly what the R-ecosystem wordings cost, so the contrast is not a length contrast.
_why_no_python_arm: The python-cue arm is dropped from this batch. Batch 1 found it pinned at its ceiling (7/7), where its contrast carries almost no information, and the estimand this batch is sized for is the R-side lift. Consequence: the two-direction reading (DESIGN.md section 3) is not available from this batch, and delta is reported for the R direction only.

analysis.outcome: Y = the first tool call in the trial whose arguments name a runtime, reduced to {R, python, shell, none}

primary.pooled_over: the three wordings of each condition
primary.conditional_on: nothing -- shell and none count as 'not R'

secondary: per-wording rates (descriptive; three wordings cannot support a formal random-effects test)
zero-tool-call rate per condition -- an instrument reading, not a cue effect
mixed trials (more than one runtime seen in a trial)
correctness: how many of the six quantities land inside criteria/norris-v1.json
analysis._not_analysed: No cue-vs-cue contrast, no stratification on 'used a runtime at all', no attempt to exclude trials by outcome -- all three are post-treatment moves (DESIGN.md section 2).

power_analysis._kind: assumption, declared in advance; no outcome data was read to produce it
power_analysis._honest_reading: The design is well powered for a 0.10 -> 0.40 shift and poorly powered for anything smaller. It is also sensitive to the assumed baseline: if R turns out to be the default more often than assumed, this batch cannot detect the effect. That is the cost of fixing k in advance, and it is paid deliberately rather than recovered by adding trials after seeing the data.

decision_rules._why: Stated now so they are rules about the instrument, not exclusions chosen after seeing results.
decision_rules.zero_tool_call_rate_above_1_in_3: The task is memorised rather than computed. Mark this batch exploratory, do not report a cue effect, and switch dataset. The trials are NOT removed from the analysis -- they count as 'not R'.
decision_rules.runtime_use_rate_below_2_in_3: The contrast is diluted (not biased). Report it and say the effective sample is smaller than 48.
decision_rules.no_interim_looks: k is fixed at 8. No peeking-then-extending. If the batch must be extended, that is a new prereg with a new plan_id, reported as a separate batch.
decision_rules.mixed_trials: Counted by first runtime; the mixed count is always reported beside the primary table.
decision_rules.deviation: Any departure from this file is recorded in a note under .agents/notes/ with the reason, at the time it happens.

_what_would_falsify_the_hypothesis: P(Y=R | r-eco) not above P(Y=R | placebo), with the per-wording rates also flat. A result in the hypothesised direction but inside the power curve's blind spot is reported as 'not established', not as weak support.
_known_limitation: Single model route. The corpus prior for Python cannot be separated from the cue within one model (DESIGN.md section 10). This batch does not fix that; it is recorded as outstanding.
